d: East Bengal FC secured a dominant 5-1 victory over Inter Kashi in the Indian Super League. Aké Arnaud Loba scored twice, while Dani Ramírez, Vishnu P.V., and substitute Łukasz Zwoliński added goals to seal the emphatic win. Despite conceding an own goal, East Bengal controlled the match with attacking brilliance, outshooting Inter Kashi 20-4 in a commanding performance.
